name: Portable Call Boards (Hero's, Warchief's, Outlaw's) spawn when summoned (#4186, #7504, #9088, #9419)
contract: Items 1913515/1913516/1913517 (Hero's/Warchief's/Outlaw's Portable Call Board) teach the item spells 995213/995214/995215, whose SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR effect summons gameobject 412000/412001/422000 at the cast destination for 5 minutes. None of the three entries had a gameobject_template row, so Spell::EffectTransmitted logged 'not exist and not created' and returned without spawning anything, even though the placement cursor appeared. The item templates for 1913515-7 live only in the realm DB (not in this repo), so this casts the item spells directly rather than through add_item/use_item.
